name: APIs.io
description: Read-only discovery over the APIs.io catalog of API providers, their APIs, and the machine-readable artifacts each publishes. Searching the catalog, reading a provider or an API, and browsing tags, taxonomy and artifacts are free and need no key. Synthesis across the catalog — ratings, cohorts, capabilities, gap analysis, stack design — is paid.

additionalInterfaces.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint. 133 tools over JSON-RPC 2.0. This is the interface this card describes; APIs.io serves no native A2A JSON-RPC endpoint.
The same catalog over REST. OpenAPI at https://apis.io/developer/api/, RFC 9728 resource metadata at https://apis.io/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/v1.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591). An agent can register itself and obtain a token with no human, using client_credentials with an AAuth-signed request. Authorization server metadata: https://apis.io/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server

scopes.apis:pro: Synthesis across the catalog: ratings, cohorts, capabilities, insights

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: A key from https://apis.io/developer/. The free tier needs no key for catalog reads.

skills.name: Search the API catalog
skills.description: Federated search across API providers, APIs and tags in one call, with match counts. Filter by tag, artifact type, industry, region or rating band. Free, no key required.
examples: Find payment APIs with an OpenAPI and an MCP server
Which providers in insurance publish machine-readable rate limits?

skills.name: Read a provider or an API
skills.description: Everything APIs.io holds about one provider: its APIs, artifacts, onboarding path, capabilities and evidence. Free, no key required.
examples: How do I onboard with Twilio?

skills.name: Rate and compare providers
skills.description: The Kin Score: a published rubric over contract quality, developer ergonomics, commercial clarity, operational transparency, governance and discoverability, plus a standalone agent-readiness score. Compare providers or whole cohorts. Paid.
examples: Compare Adyen and Stripe on agent readiness
Rank open banking providers by contract quality

skills.name: Find what to fix on a listing
skills.description: For a provider improving its own score: the ranked remediation list, which band gate is unmet, and what a given fix would move. Paid.
examples: What is the highest-value fix for our listing?
What is holding us at agent-ready?

skills.name: Report that the catalog is wrong
skills.description: Tell APIs.io its record about a provider is incorrect. Free and unmetered, always: correcting our own error is not a paid feature. Also reachable over REST at POST /v1/providers/{slug}/correction.
examples: Your record says we have no OpenAPI; here is the URL
